Build Phases (Dependency Order)

The guide stresses dependency order, not feature order. This keeps the platform stable and reduces rework.

Phase 0 - Infrastructure

Monorepo scaffold, shared UI, plotting wrappers, i18n, API base, auth, saved experiments core.

Phase 1 - Core Scientific MVP

ThermoLab v1, ChaosLab v1, gallery, compare mode, exports.

Phase 2 - Mechanics + Research

Projectile, oscillators, pendulum, double pendulum, research mode.

Phase 3 - Advanced Scientific Layer

Thermo cycles, ODE lab, PDE lab, statistical physics mini-labs.

Testing Strategy

Backend Tests

  • Unit tests for model equations
  • Solver accuracy tests
  • Validation tests and regression snapshots

Frontend Tests

  • Form validation
  • Workspace rendering
  • Save/load experiment flows
